0022600127.text: The Denver Nuggets, now 0-1 and 11th in the West, host the 0-2 Golden State Warriors, who are 13th in the West, in the third game of the 2026-27 season for Denver. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Golden State is without Al Horford (back), Brandin Podziemski (back), Draymond Green (back), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Denver's most recent win over Golden State came 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026, with no games yet between them this season.
